newsitem.title: USA: Reckson acquires 10 buildings for $21 mln.
newsitem.headline: Reckson acquires 10 buildings for $21 mln.

text.p: Reckson Associates Realty Corp said Monday it has contracted to acquire a 10 building portfolio totaling 447,000 square feet of research and development and industrial space from an unnamed institutional owner for about $21 million.

The properties are located in Reckson's Vanderbilt Industrial Park in Hauppauge, N.Y., which is, said the company, part of the second largest industrial park in the nation, employing 54,000 people. The buildings are currently 85 percent leased.
With this acquisition, Reckson will own 44 buildings with more than two million square feet in the park, further solidifying its position as the park's largest landlord, said the company.

The company said its Hauppauge portfolio is currently 97 percent leased and it expects increased leasing activity in these additional properties to stabilize at a similar level within the next 12 to 18 months.
Reckson is a real estate investment trust specializing in office and industrial properties in suburban New York City.
